description: This file defines the Vtiger_MailBox class, which manages IMAP/POP3 mailbox connections, folder operations, message retrieval, and message flagging within the vtiger CRM MailScanner module.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailBox
classes.description: Class to work with server mailbox, handling connection, folder management, message retrieval, and message flagging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes mailbox settings based on provided scanner info, setting default ports and SSL options.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the mailbox using IMAP/POP3, with fallback to different connection strings.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a specific mailbox folder, reusing existing connection if possible.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for emails in a folder based on last scan time and search criteria.

methods.name: getFolders
methods.description: Retrieves list of folder names from the mailbox.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Fetches an email message by message ID, returning a MailRecord object.

methods.name: markMessage
methods.description: Marks a message with a specified flag, e.g., \Seen.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the IMAP connection, expunging messages if needed.
